speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with left chest pain, a productive cough with purulent sputum, and shortness of breath. To begin my assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-acquired pneumonia (likely Staphylococcus aureus post-influenza).

Based on your history of untreated influenza and current symptoms of purulent sputum and chest pain, I need to confirm the extent of the infection. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Chest X-Ray.
